messages:
evan: Heads-up — found a confusing corner in the Go SDK generator semantics when our request deadline fires while the client is performing an auth refresh. Users hit either a silent EOF or a transient error and aren't sure whether to retry.

priya: Can you paste the tiny repro and the exact symptoms?

evan: Minimal case: create a generator with a parent ctx that has a deadline, then auth middleware forces a reconnect during the stream. Sometimes the loop never exits quickly, sometimes Err() is nil, sometimes it returns a generic io error.

evan: Rough snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), time.Now().Add(3*time.Second))
defer cancel()
g, _ := client.Generator(ctx, modelID, nil)
for g.Next() {
  fmt.Print(g.Value().Text)
}
log.Printf("done err=%v", g.Err())
```

hao: UX suggestion: make iteration explicitly cancellation-aware. Two options: add NextWithCtx(ctx) or add NextWithDeadline(deadline). Prefer NextWithCtx for flexibility. Also, Close() should be documented as safe to call from any goroutine and idempotent.

priya: I like NextWithCtx. Also we should introduce clear sentinel errors (sdk.ErrUserCanceled, sdk.ErrTransient) so apps can programmatically decide to resume vs abort. Current opaque errors cause users to re-create generators unnecessarily.

evan: Agreed. For onboarding we should change quickstart to use: `defer g.Close()` + `for g.NextWithCtx(ctx) { ... }` and then `if errors.Is(g.Err(), sdk.ErrUserCanceled) { /* normal */ }`. That will simplify the common case.

hao: Implementation note: NextWithCtx should select on provided ctx and internal msg channel; on ctx.Done() set Err() to context.Canceled and return false. Close() should use sync.Once to avoid double-close races. Add unit tests that simulate auth rotation (auth proxy returns 401, then 200) and assert no goroutine leak and deterministic Err().

priya: I'll draft a PR with: NextWithCtx alias NextCtx, idempotent Close, export ErrTransient and ErrUserCanceled, and update quickstart sample + samples repo with an IterChan helper. PR link when ready.

ci-bot: queued tests for branch: nextwithctx-and-close-fixes (run 1/5) :eyes:

docs-bot: when PR merges, please add a short migration note in the Go quickstart and a one-line blurb in the API reference clarifying error semantics for generators.

evan: Thanks — if we land this, it should cut down the support tickets about ambiguous generator cancel behavior. :+1:
